name: BRAND TEXT
description:
At Infrared Saunas we are delighted to now sell Waterstar Sauna products through our website.
Waterstar Saunas are an excellent choice for your home. The Waterstar range of sauna suits is both stylish and affordable which means more people are able to experience the health benefits of infrared sauna technology from the comfort of their home. Waterstar Saunas blend traditional sauna design with contemporary lines. Whether you choose an indoor or outdoor sauna suit, they are eye catching design features that complement all interior styles and garden designs.
Waterstar Saunas use a range of infrared sauna technology to help customers achieve optimum wellness and health benefits. The Far Infrared sauna technology effectively targets weight loss and the Near Infrared sauna technology assists in pain management, circulation and skin rejuvenation. Waterstar Far Infrared sauna suits have comfortable seating which enhances the benefits of relaxation and wellness. Waterstar Saunas have a large range of sauna accessories at all budgets that you can use to customise your infrared sauna suit. Imagine enjoying the relaxation and health benefits of your infrared sauna while surrounded by your own bespoke personalisation.
The stylish design of the Waterstar Infrared Saunas is a long standing customer favourite as there are a range of sizes and designs for all budgets. The Waterstar Infrared Sauna brand has made it possible for everyone access to the health benefits of saunas.
